sources.snippet: Overview ControlNet-v1-1 is a neural network architecture developed by lllyasviel that enables spatial control over diffusion models during image generation. This model functions as a conditioning mechanism that allows you to guide image synthesis using control inputs such as edge maps, pose skeletons, depth maps, or semantic segmentations, providing fine-grained control over the spatial ...

sources.snippet: Sources: README.md 43-58 Model Architecture All ControlNet v1.1 models share the same neural network architecture as ControlNet 1.0, ensuring compatibility and consistent behavior. The models are designed to work with Stable Diffusion 1.5 and require the base model "v1-5-pruned.ckpt" to function.
